transcript: Dissociate the N2 triple bond to 2.2 Angstroms and show the active space pi bonding and antibonding orbitals.
narrative: For **N₂ Homonuclear Triple-Bond Dissociation**, we solved the electronic state using continuous phase-space kinetic transport. The active-space natural occupations relaxed to `[2.0, 2.0, 1.997, 1.9925, 1.4778, 1.3366]` with an informational entropy of **10.7547 bits** and total energy of **-2882.6241 eV**. Notice how the kinetic collision operator regularizes topological mean-field singularities, generating the smooth natural orbital isosurfaces visible in your 3D viewport.
